convert_opt_checkpoint: convert a fairseq OPT checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model saved to an output folder
load_checkpoint: load and transform a fairseq OPT checkpoint state dict into HuggingFace-compatible weight keys
run_convert_cli: run the CLI script to convert a fairseq OPT model.pt checkpoint to a HuggingFace OPTModel
split_qkv_weights: split combined QKV projection weights into separate q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj tensors
rename_checkpoint_keys: rename legacy checkpoint keys to match HuggingFace OPTModel naming conventions
